model_units: G=Mtotal=a=1; times are dimensionless model time, not Gyr

axes.seed: whole randomized library; treatments and nodes are paired
axes.field: fixed_halo or responsive self-gravitating represented halo

missing_value: Empty CSV cells mean not applicable before the actual t20 release; never zero

columns.actual_time: actual recorded integration time, model time
columns.omega: rotor angular speed, inverse model time
columns.rotor_L: axial rotor angular momentum, M a^2/model time
columns.total_bar_impulse: accumulated halo angular impulse from bar since t0, M a^2/model time
columns.shape_work: external shape-growth work since t0, energy
columns.pattern_work: external pattern-speed-clamp work since t0, energy
columns.postrelease_bar_impulse: bar-mediated halo angular impulse since this population own release, M a^2/model time
columns.postrelease_rotor_bar_residual: postrelease halo bar impulse plus rotor L change, angular momentum

uncertainty: Nominal pointwise t7 for eight libraries; paired t3 for four refinements. Not calibrated simultaneous coverage or numerical bounds.
verification: inspect.py recomputes saved scalar arithmetic, retaining full library pairing; no orbits rerun
noise_operator: none; collisionless deterministic particle evolution for each random initial library
